name: São Tomé and Príncipe
officialName: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green, the yellow one wider, with a red triangle at the hoist and two black five-pointed stars on the yellow stripe.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the vegetation, yellow the sun and cocoa, red the struggle for independence, and the two stars the two main islands.

hook: São Tomé and Príncipe puts two black stars, one per island, on a wide yellow band between green stripes, with a red hoist triangle.
trivia: The equator passes through Ilhéu das Rolas, an islet just off São Tomé.
In 1919 Arthur Eddington photographed a solar eclipse on Príncipe, helping confirm Einstein's general theory of relativity.
